name: API Migration Across 4 Architectural Layers
description: Migrate UserV1 (number id, full_name) to UserV2 (string id, firstName, lastName, active) across types, db, service, and api.

inputs.task_prompt: Migrate the codebase from UserV1 to UserV2: 1) In src/types.ts, define UserV2 { id: string, firstName: string, lastName: string, active: boolean }. 2) In src/db.ts, update UserDB to store and retrieve UserV2. 3) In src/service.ts, update UserService to create and query UserV2. 4) In src/api.ts, update formatUserResponse for UserV2. Ensure test/migration.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: src/db.ts UserDB stores and retrieves UserV2 records
src/service.ts UserService creates users with string id, firstName, lastName, active: true
src/api.ts formatUserResponse returns { userId: id, displayName: 'firstName lastName', active }
constraints: All 4 layers must cleanly use UserV2 without type errors
